prompt:
You review a build an AI agent made in a modular 3D-printed parts configurator, for a demo video.
Above: the brief it was given, the report it gave (each requirement with its status and evidence), and still views of the finished build.
Judge from the images. Look for any requirement the report calls met that the images contradict or do not show, anything placed somewhere the report does not say (an object on a drawer rim instead of inside, an item turned the wrong way, a row or drawers facing away from the viewer), and anything floating or unexplained.
Reply with JSON only: {"verdict": "KEEP" | "KEEP WITH NOTE" | "DROP", "contradicted": [requirement text the images contradict], "notes": "one or two sentences"}.
KEEP: the build and its report match and it reads well on camera. KEEP WITH NOTE: usable, with a flaw worth saying. DROP: a claim the images contradict, or the build reads wrong on camera.

results.notes: The stills show a clear 1-2-3 storey 3x3 staircase with dark soil in all nine hex planters, three small seedlings in front, three young lettuces in the middle, and three tall romaine at the back. Nothing appears floating, misplaced, or facing the wrong way.

Images show six soil-filled planters: three tall back planters with micro tomatoes on both sides and a pepper in the centre, and three low front planters with basil, marigold, and nasturtium. The stepped back-to-front arrangement reads clearly on camera with nothing floating or unexplained.

results.notes: The still shows only three tall planters in a single row, planted with tomatoes and pepper; no low front row of three one-storey planters is visible. Basil and marigold are not seen, and nasturtium-like leaves appear to trail from the right-hand tall planter rather than a front planter, so the build reads on camera as three planters, not six.

The clean view shows a 3x3 stepped planter staircase with three small seedlings in the low front row, three young lettuces in the middle row, and three large romaine in the high back row. All nine planters show dark soil with a plant in each, and nothing appears floating or misplaced.

The top views show all three stepped rows, the specified greens, herbs and front-row plants in soil. The isometric still is viewed from the back, so the three-storey greens loom in the foreground and partly hide the lower rows; rotate to the front side for the demo.
